project.name: VINRelease
project.summary: A CALL-E-powered title-exception desk that calls authorized auctions and lienholders, converts conversations into typed case transitions, and stops when human judgment is required.
project.ai_usage: CALL-E makes approved phone calls and extracts typed recipient results; deterministic validation and state transitions govern downstream action.
project.codex_usage: Codex implemented and tested the app, resolved a real CALL-E schema rejection, verified a terminal provider call, and prepared the public demo and contribution.
